name: Stronghold
slug: The Stronghold is a familiar party location whose Great Hall serves as a mental target for controlling portal destinations.
description: The Stronghold is a familiar location containing the Great Hall, which serves as a known mental reference point for the party. It is associated with Dana’s suggestion that Gerk use familiar places as mental targets when attempting to control portal destinations.

notes: The Great Hall of the Stronghold is a familiar location Dana suggests Gerk use as a mental target when attempting to control portal destinations.
Gerk attempts to open a portal to the Great Hall but instead reaches a forest near Langdale.
